definitions.explanation: A sudden, painful involuntary contraction of the calf muscle. From こむら (calf) + {返|がえ}り (turning over). Often strikes during sleep, swimming, or exercise, especially when one is tired or dehydrated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧こむら{返|がえ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a calf cramp in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧こむら{返|がえ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: I got a calf cramp during exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、こむら{返|がえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすいそうだ。
examples.english: Apparently, when you're short on fluids, you're prone to calf cramps.

notes:
An everyday word for a painful calf-muscle cramp. Commonly triggered by fatigue, cold, dehydration, or mineral imbalance, and frequent during sleep or swimming.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こむら{返|がえ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a calf cramp occurs
- こむら{返|がえ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to get a calf cramp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{痙攣|けいれん}→痙攣：06301_keiren⟧: convulsion, spasm — the broader medical term for involuntary muscle contraction
- つる: to cramp up (verb) — the colloquial verb, as in ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つる (one's leg cramps)
